scope: Registered Tarn outcome extension: error namespaces, transaction state and retry permissions across PyMySQL text, MySQL Connector/Python text and binary prepared SQL, registered strong KV v1 and the Rust SDK. Equivalent/difference entries describe the stated SQL behavior; Tarn-specific storage faults and KV histories are not paired MySQL oracle claims.

contracts.description: 1062/23000 rolls back the statement and preserves preceding transaction writes.
Strict serializable validation returns 1213/40001 and ends the transaction without its writes.
1205/HY000 for a row-lock wait rolls back the statement; earlier writes can commit.
Autocommit, local and RC commits preserve 1180/40003 for lost, malformed or explicitly unknown replies; one completed increment at most.
A lost SQL connection cannot deliver a server SQLSTATE; a possibly executed mutation remains unknown and is not replayed.
Confirmed logical COMMIT can precede physical APPLY; raw native reads lag while SQL, registered KV and the Rust SDK refuse the unfinished row, then agree after APPLY.
Lost durable PREPARE receipts with unavailable participant status stay 1180/40003 until resolved; a confirmed COMMITTED decision returns success despite missing status and pending APPLY.
A unique operation record committed with the effect resolves a lost local COMMIT reply without a second increment.
Strong KV retains contract/MySQL/Tarantool error namespaces, rejects stale schema/ownership and oversized batches, and cannot inherit or commit buffered SQL work.
